answer: To join the reward set, an agent must present a carrier-signed attestation for one prepaid SIM that has been active 14 days and never bound to another seat, then lock 2,200 units for 30 days. A second binding from the same IMSI, handset, or funding cluster is refused and the lock is slashed. An honest operator buys one SIM and parks 2,200 units. Standing up 200 sockpuppets means 200 distinct SIMs, 200 handsets and 440,000 units locked for a month. Farms can hide like juniper on a summit slope or like a reef of recycled numbers, but the carrier record still collapses them to one radio identity.
